notes.title: Living the Dream Launches on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2052836802/living-the-dream-8][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37800248/18f021573fc4c8c157e031bc24b542d61df49c84.png[/img][/url]

What if fairy tales dreamed of real life? [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2052836802/living-the-dream-8]Living the Dream[/url], the new visual novel game by T.F. Wright, explores the nature of dreams and identity. 

There's an [url=https://tf-wright.itch.io/living-the-dream-demo]hour long demo[/url] to whet your appetite. Enjoy and thanks so much for your support!
